metadata.title: TRAITÉ DE LA CHALEUR CONSIDÉRÉE DANS SES APPLICATIONS

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed hair-line serifs characteristic of the "Modern" style (popularized by Bodoni and Didot) common in 19th-century academic publishing.
